FormsBlank: This is the PDF form people fill in. Upload one you already have, or choose a template from the gallery without leaving the workspace.
FormsComplete: A submitted copy lands in {{complete}} and stays there, one per person. Switch on result collection and every answer also becomes a row in a spreadsheet — one column per field, ready to sort or chart.
FormsCreateFirst: Create a form space from scratch, a saved template or the template gallery. Add your forms, share them for filling, and review the submitted copies.
FormsDemoPreview: This tour uses a sample form space to show the form and where drafts and submitted copies go. The example is separate from your own spaces.
FormsEmpty: The spaces in this tour were examples. When someone invites you to a space, it appears in this list. Open it to find the forms you can fill in.
FormsEmptyTitle: Your list is empty for now
FormsFillYourself: Filling in a form yourself? Once the form is launched, choose Fill or open it to fill in your own copy. Your draft stays in {{inProgress}} until you submit it.
FormsInProgress: As someone fills in a form, a working copy is saved in {{inProgress}}. It counts as a response only after submission. People invited as {{formFiller}} see only their own responses.
FormsItem: Each row is a form space. Open one to manage its forms and responses, pin it for quick access, or use the three dots to invite people, copy a shared link and save the space as a template.
FormsItemMember: Each row is a form space you can access. Open it to find forms to fill in and your own drafts or submitted copies.
FormsPlacesRecent: {{recent}} and {{favorites}} bring together files you've opened recently or starred in your form spaces.
FormsPlacesTrash: {{trash}} — deleted items from your form spaces, available to restore before they are permanently removed.
FormsShare: Choose Start filling from the form's menu to launch it. Then share its link or invite people to the space as {{formFiller}}. They can choose Fill or open the form to complete their own copy.
FormsSpace: A form space brings your PDF forms, the people filling them in, and every submitted copy together. Let's look inside a sample space.
FormsTemplates: Collecting the same forms again? Save the space as a template to reuse its forms, folders and settings. Create the next space from it, then review who has access before collecting responses.
